statements.quote: The increase in servers and networking net revenue was driven by growth in our AI-optimized server offerings and, to a lesser extent, our traditional server and networking offerings.
statements.notes: The sentence is about servers and networking net revenue (a product line within ISG), not total company revenue. This sentence names no year; the preceding sentence refers to Fiscal 2025.
